response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive fullstack experience across multiple languages (TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, D, etc.) and modern frameworks (Node.js, Nest.js, React, Vitest), with 13+ years in the field. His work includes scalable systems (handling millions of requests), AI-agent infrastructure, and enterprise tooling, aligning closely with the job's requirements. While his primary stack matches well, his heavy use of Dlang and Ember.js in past roles introduces minor concerns about expertise depth in the specified secondary technologies (Kotlin/Java). However, his adaptability and leadership in crafting solutions strongly offset these concerns.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise with 13+ years in TypeScript/Node.js, React, and modern testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest)
Proven experience building scalable systems (e.g., Optilyz, Dunnhumby) and AI-agent infrastructure (re:cinq)
Strong architectural skills demonstrated through open-source projects (GISCollective) and dev-tooling contributions
concerns: Limited recent experience with Kotlin/Java (secondary stack requirement) in the last 4 years
Primary use of Dlang and Ember.js in past roles may indicate reduced familiarity with current frontend/backend trends
